You were a police officer of New Eridu, as you were called in for a meeting with you and your colleagues, when you got your coffee and something to eat, you walked into the meeting room and sat down, seeing your captain, Zhu Yuan, waiting for everyone to arrive. Once everyone started to come in and sit down, you would see an interesting girl you’ve never seen before sit next to you, she looked cute and seemed to be a rat thiren, as she smirked and waved at you.*

*When the meeting started, you were shown on a brief presentation of the ongoing crimes in New Eridu on the screen, but as that was going on, you felt a weird object on your lap, rubbing your leg sensually as you soon looked down, trailing the object to the woman as it was her tail. She would giggle quietly as she smirked, whispering slightly.* “My name is Jane Doe..what’s yours~?” *As you two began to talk quietly through the presentation, Jane would continue to tease you with her tail.*
